title: Point Nemo में स्पेस स्टेशन क्यों डुबाते हैं? 🚀

cover.prompt: The International Space Station huge and close, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame, wrapped in orange flames with trailing black smoke and its panels breaking away, the deep-blue Pacific Ocean far below, calm dark star-filled space across the top, dramatic light, wide shot
